[University of Glasgow - The Hunterian - Visit - What's On?]

Highlights include works by Mary Armour, Duncan Shanks, James Paterson, George Henry, William Crosbie and Robert Colquhoun.

…

The works are interspersed throughout the Hunterian Art Gallery main gallery, offering fresh dialogues with our permanent displays. Entry is free. Open Tuesday–Sunday, 10.00am–5.00pm.

…

Spanning drawings, prints and watercolours from the 15th century to the present day, the collection brings together works by artists ranging from Rembrandt to Picasso, and Matisse to Mackintosh.
